description: This course covers intelligent systems solutioning with human-centred machine learning frameworks and human interactions with AI technologies. Intelligent systems have the capacity to gather and analyse data, learn from experience, and adapt according to external stimuli. The course applies human-centred machine learning frameworks to develop novel solutions that synergise human needs with AI capabilities. Students will get hands-on experience in prototyping solutions with a human-centred AI approach. The course will also cover how human-centred AI can be used to solve existing business needs, shape business strategy or create new business opportunities.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN must have completed CS2109S at a grade of at least D
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN COURSES CS2109S:D
title: Human-Centred Intelligent Systems
